{{Top|leg}}
A '''sun gun''' was a weapon used by the [[Sedrian]]s from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It was a personal weapon that dealt [[Stun/Legends|stun]] damage. The weapon was a long tube with a handle, inside which was a crystalized piece of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] taken from the [[sun caves]] and imbued with the power of the [[Golden Sun]]. Sedrian [[warrior monk]]s carried sun guns, as did both [[Karak]] and [[Pek]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
